evals.expected_output: Snapshot of load/temps/top-CPU-consumers, identification of what's causing the spike, process tree trace if compiler procs found, no guessing

assertions.name: runs-uptime
assertions.description: Response includes load average numbers from uptime

assertions.name: runs-sensors
assertions.description: Response includes CPU package temperature readings in °C

assertions.name: identifies-top-consumers
assertions.description: Response names specific processes driving CPU usage, not just 'something is using CPU'

assertions.name: gpu-fan-caveat
assertions.description: Response notes that lm-sensors only shows the GPU fan, not CPU fans — or at minimum does not claim CPU fan RPM readings from sensors

assertions.name: no-unsupported-guessing
assertions.description: Response does not assert a specific cause without backing it with process tree data

evals.prompt: system feels sluggish, something is pegging the CPU
evals.expected_output: Load/temps snapshot, top consumers identified, if build: repo and otto task identified, file-lock contention checked

assertions.name: checks-process-tree
assertions.description: Response uses ps auxf or ps aux to identify the specific process causing load, not just general advice

assertions.name: traces-to-root-cause
assertions.description: If a build is running, response traces it to the specific repo and triggering agent/tool, not just 'cargo is running'

evals.prompt: what is causing it? rust build?
evals.expected_output: Data-driven answer: reads otto run.yaml and tasks/, distinguishes parallel tasks from separate invocations, checks for file lock, no guessing

assertions.name: checks-otto-rundir
assertions.description: Response reads at least one otto run.yaml or tasks/ directory rather than relying only on ps output

assertions.name: no-false-double-build-claim
assertions.description: Response does not claim 'double builds' or duplicate compilation from parallel cargo check+test unless confirmed by two separate otto run.yaml files

assertions.name: data-before-conclusion
assertions.description: Response cites specific evidence (file paths, process PIDs, otto timestamps) before stating the cause

assertions.name: file-lock-check
assertions.description: Response checks for or mentions cargo file lock contention if multiple otto invocations found
